prompt.en: Which game has the most registered players in Canada?
prompt.fr: Quel sport compte le plus de joueurs inscrits au Canada?

explanation.en: More people sign up to play soccer than any other game in Canada, even though hockey is the sport Canadians watch most.
explanation.fr: Plus de gens s'inscrivent au soccer qu'à tout autre sport au Canada, même si le hockey est le sport que les Canadiens regardent le plus.

source.quote: Soccer has the most registered players of any game in Canada.

verification.evidence: Soccer has the most registered players of any game in Canada.
